description: One bank of sixteen faders held in a hundred slots, with a second output that reads a slot picked by voltage without disturbing the one being played

params.text: Sets the voltage on its channel of the output, over the span chosen in the menu
Attenuates the voltage at the Mod CV jack before it is added to the faders, 0 to 1
Picks which of the hundred slots is played and edited
While on, the slot is picked by hand and a cable in the preset jack no longer moves the selection
Copies every fader of the slot being edited
Writes the copied faders into the slot being edited
Sets how long the faders take to reach their new values after a slot change, 0 to 10
Pushes the slots after the one being edited along by one place and empties it; the hundredth slot is lost
Removes the slot being edited and pulls every later slot back one place
While on, the voltages at the Program jack are written into the faders
While on, the number of channels at the Program jack also sets how many faders reach the output

inputs.text: Modulates the faders, one channel per fader, scaled by the Mod CV Amount knob
Picks the slot by voltage, 0.1V per slot over 0-10V; while LOCK is on this jack is passed over
Writes the faders from a cable, one channel per fader, while the module is enabled
Switches the writing on by cable: a monophonic cable above 1V switches all sixteen on, and a polyphonic one switches each fader on by its own channel
Picks the slot read by the Pattern CV output, 0.1V per slot over 0-10V, without moving the slot being played

outputs.text: The faders of the slot being played, as one polyphonic cable with as many channels as the menu is set to
The faders of the slot picked by the Pattern Adr jack, as one polyphonic cable; nothing on the panel moves as this sweeps through the slots

notes: click anywhere on a fader to send it straight to the mouse, rather than dragging it from where it stands
the Program jack and the Enable switch are how a run of slots is recorded: enable the writing, sweep the address and the values are written into each slot as it passes
menu: Polyphonic Channels — sets how many faders reach the output, 1 to 16
Range — sets the span of every fader: -10/10V, -5/5V, -3/3V, -2/2V, -1/1V, 0/10V, 0/5V, 0/3V, 0/2V or 0/1V
Snap Size — rounds the output to a step: None, Semi, 0.1, Pat 32, 0.5, Pat 16, 1 or Pat 8, where Pat X means ten volts divided by X, for addressing patterns elsewhere
Randomize — fills the faders at random within the span
Use Adr for Prog — writes the values from the Program jack into the slot picked by the Pattern Adr jack in place of the slot being played, for recording fast through the bank

inputs.0:

unpatched it reads the Preset Selection knob; a negative voltage does nothing here.

unpatched it reads the faders.
inputs.3:

unpatched it reads the Enable button.
inputs.4:
